name: bay-run
description: Connect Cursor to Bay Run's URL-only Streamable HTTP MCP server with exactly three bounded tools: coprocessor, run_pin, and solve_task. The coprocessor independently guards user_text and every document even when another Guard or action-safety signal already blocks or escalates, combines block > escalate > allow, reranks only after all Guards allow, defaults to decision-only responses (omit_raw_result=true), and fails closed on unavailable or malformed decisions; it never generates text or executes tools, and receipts do not prove answer correctness.
